items.q: Is retinal suitable for sensitive skin?
items.a: Yes. The advanced encapsulation technology makes retinal release gradually, significantly reducing irritation compared to traditional retinol. We recommend starting with every other day.
Most customers notice a difference in hydration and radiance within the first week, visible pore reduction by weeks two and three, and a full transformation within 4-8 weeks.

items.q: Can I use it with sunscreen?
items.a: You must! Retinal makes your skin more sensitive to the sun. We recommend using the serum at night and applying SPF 50 sunscreen in the morning.
We currently accept cash on delivery only. No bank card needed — pay the courier when your order arrives.
